about: Rules shared by the Rust commands (src-tauri/src/todo.rs) and the browser mock (src/lib/ipc/mock-todo.test.ts). See ADR 0009. steps run in order. Tasks and Lists are referenced by the index of the n-th successfully created one (`task`, `list`; a literal string is used as an id, null is the Inbox). ops: create{title,list?}, complete, reopen, move{task,list}, list_create{name}, list_rename{list,name}, list_emoji{list,emoji}, list_delete{list,choice: 'delete'|'inbox'|{list: n}} (the n-th deletion is kept for list_restore{deletion}). results: 'ok' or the error code of each step. inbox: titles in the Inbox. lists: List names in order. emojis: their emoji. counts: [Inbox open count, then each List's]. all: the All view as [[group name, [titles]]] (Inbox first, empty groups left out). expect lists just the keys to check. Dates: a case may pin `today` and `now` (default 2026-10-21 14:05, a Wednesday); a step may pin its own, which is how Overdue Tasks are made (set a past date while 'today' is in the past). create{title,list?,date?,time?}, set_when{task,date?,time?}, move_overdue{date} (the n-th is kept for undo_move{move}). dues: every open Task as [title, due date, due time] in the All view's order. today: {overdue, tasks} titles (Tasks done today depend on the real clock, so Rust and Vitest test those apart). upcoming: {overdue, days: [[date, titles]]}. day_counts: [[date, open Tasks]] from today to the end of 2027. sidebar_today: [Today's count (open Tasks due today plus Overdue), the Overdue part]. Repeat: set_when{task,date?,time?,repeat?: {freq,every,weekdays?,anchor?,mode}}; complete and skip take the step's clock (today); reopen_occurrence{occurrence: n} reopens the n-th occurrence copy recorded by a complete. repeats: every open repeating Task as [title, freq, every, days (weekday bitmask or day of month), mode]. done: titles in Done, newest first. Sheet: priority{task,priority}, wont_do{task}, delete{task}, restore{task}, update{task,title,notes,session} (autosave of the sheet), comment_add{task,body}, comment_edit{comment,body}, comment_delete{comment}, comment_restore{comment} (comments are referenced by the index of the n-th added). priorities: every open Task as [title, priority] in the All view's order. wont: titles of Won't do Tasks in Done. comments: [[owner, [bodies, a * after edited ones]]] for every live created Task (an occurrence copy is 'title (occurrence)'). history: the lines of the case's `history_of` Task (default the first), newest first. Keep fixtures free of a session edit interleaved with other writes to the same Task: ties in the change log's millisecond clock would order them differently in Rust and the mock.
